parameters.query:
WITH incoming AS (
  SELECT $1::text AS idempotency_key, $2::jsonb AS payload
),
validated AS (
  SELECT idempotency_key, payload
  FROM incoming
  WHERE jsonb_typeof(payload) = 'object'
    AND payload ?& ARRAY['schema_version', 'event_id', 'document_id', 'revision_id', 'approved_at', 'document_sha256', 'fields']
    AND payload->>'schema_version' = 'invoiceops.approved.v1'
    AND length(payload->>'event_id') BETWEEN 1 AND 64
    AND idempotency_key = 'invoiceops-v1-' || (payload->>'event_id')
    AND payload->>'document_sha256' ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
    AND jsonb_typeof(payload->'fields') = 'object'
    AND jsonb_typeof(payload->'fields'->'items') = 'array'
),
attempted AS (
  INSERT INTO invoiceops_n8n_demo_records (idempotency_key, payload)
  SELECT idempotency_key, payload
  FROM validated
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO UPDATE
    SET idempotency_key = EXCLUDED.idempotency_key
    WHERE invoiceops_n8n_demo_records.payload = EXCLUDED.payload
  RETURNING idempotency_key
)
SELECT 'processed'::text AS status, 200::integer AS response_code
FROM attempted
UNION ALL
SELECT 'conflict'::text AS status, 409::integer AS response_code
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM validated)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM attempted)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'invalid'::text AS status, 400::integer AS response_code
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM validated)
